language.title: Language
language.dirNote: Screens switch direction now; system elements (horizontal lists and Android arrows) follow after the app is reopened once.
language.migrating: Texts are moving to both languages in stages · anything not moved yet appears in Arabic.

lease.scheduleRead: Read from the Ejar file · review it before creating; creating the contract approves it.
lease.scheduleComputedFromFile: Warning: the payment schedule couldn't be read from the Ejar file · the dates below are computed, not read; match them to the file's schedule before creating.
lease.scheduleComputed: Computed from the contract term and payment cycle.
lease.applyBody: Due dates and last payment days in {{n}} contract(s) will be corrected to their files' schedules; amounts and payments stay as they are. Apply?
lease.compareTitle: What was read vs. what exists
lease.compareNote: Tap an item to choose what gets written · empty values are filled by default; different ones only with your approval.
lease.noSlot: No field in the app · shown only
lease.lessorDiffers: The lessor in the contract ({{name}}) differs from the company name · lessor data never overwrites company data.
lease.lessorCrDiffers: The lessor's CR in the contract differs from the company's · lessor data never overwrites company data.

check.count: The schedule has {{actual}} rows; the contract states {{expected}} rent payments
check.regular: A schedule payment ({{actual}}) differs from the regular rent payment ({{expected}})
check.last: The last schedule payment ({{actual}}) differs from the stated last rent payment ({{expected}})

lease.scheduleSumMismatch: The Ejar schedule total {{sum}} differs from the contract total {{total}} · correct the rent, services or parking until they match, or save as draft
lease.splitOther: The file total has an unexplained amount: {{amount}} (not rent, services or parking) · check the file

assets.title: Assets

memo.cost: Cost of asset “{{name}}” · owner's contribution in kind
memo.convert: Conversion of purchase invoice {{no}} to assets

assets.menuSub: Asset register, book values and depreciation

ui.empty: No assets yet · add one, or convert unit contents or an old purchase invoice from “Tools”.
ui.name: Asset name
ui.newNote: Added “awaiting cost” with no entry or depreciation until its cost comes from a purchase invoice or is entered.
ui.setCostNote: An item without an invoice (owned before the app or brought by the owner): debit the category account, credit capital 3100, with catch-up depreciation since purchase, dated today.
ui.costDone: Cost recorded and its entry posted
ui.transferNote: Depreciation for the days before the transfer stays on the old unit; then cost and accumulated depreciation move to the new one.
ui.disposeNote: Depreciation is posted to the date, then the book value is recorded as a disposal loss (5700). It stays in the register as “disposed”.
ui.sellNote: Depreciation is posted to the date · the difference from book value is a gain (4400) or a loss (5700).
ui.sellDone: Sale recorded and its entry posted

convert.title: Convert an old purchase invoice
convert.pick: Invoices expensed without lines · choose one
convert.previewTitle: Before executing · nothing is written before “Execute”
convert.dated: Entries are dated today, not on the invoice date, so earlier periods don't change.
convert.undoConfirm: Reverses the reclassification, the catch-up and the monthly depreciation of its assets, deletes its assets, and restores the expense.

contents.title: Unit contents to assets
contents.note: Each selected item becomes an asset “in service” and “awaiting cost” with no entry; its description goes to notes · the category is suggested from the name and can be changed.

review.pendingNote: {{n}} asset(s) with no cost or depreciation · record the cost from the Assets screen, or link it to an invoice line.
review.dupNote: Depreciation for {{month}} was posted {{n}} times from more than one device · reverse the extra.

lines.title: Invoice lines
lines.note: Optional · lines that become assets go to their category account at cost plus their tax share; the rest goes to the category expense.
lines.locked: This invoice's assets have depreciation or movements · its lines can't be edited

err.name: Enter the asset name
err.ended: The asset is disposed or sold · no operation is possible
err.pending: The asset is awaiting its cost · record the cost first
err.notPending: The asset's cost is already recorded
err.cost: Enter a cost greater than zero
err.life: Life in months is a whole number from 1 to 600
err.salvage: Residual value must be less than the cost
err.periodClosed: Depreciation for {{month}} is posted · choose a later date
err.beforePurchase: The date is before the asset's purchase date
err.sameUnit: Choose a unit other than its current one
err.lifeLocked: Depreciation has started · life and residual value are locked
err.convertSum: Assets total ({{sum}}) exceeds what the invoice expensed ({{max}})
err.convertEmpty: Mark at least one line as an asset
err.qty: Quantity is a whole number from 1 to 500
err.undoBlocked: An asset from this invoice was transferred, disposed or sold · the conversion can't be reversed
err.linesSum: Lines total ({{sum}}) doesn't equal the amount before tax ({{base}})
err.purchaseLocked: This invoice's assets have depreciation or movements · edit the asset or reverse the conversion

chat.title: Chat
chat.menuSub: Direct and group chats between members
chat.needAccount: Chat works after signing in to an organisation · every chat is between its members
chat.empty: No chats yet · start one with a member
chat.noPeople: No members in the directory yet · a member appears after their first sync
chat.nameOnly: You have no access to this record · name only
chat.attachmentsLater: Photos, files and message notifications work after billing is enabled
chat.linkTitle: Link the message to a record
chat.maintenanceLater: Linking maintenance requests works once they are built
chat.rejected: The server refused to create this chat · your supervision may have been removed
chat.supSaveFailed: Could not save section supervision · permissions were saved
chat.ownerSees: The organization owner can view the organization’s chats
chat.reviewReadOnly: Read-only review · ends when closed; each new opening needs a new reason
chat.adminsOnlySend: Only admins can send in this group
chat.historyFailed: Could not load the edit history
chat.channelMembersAuto: Channel members follow their permissions automatically: those with access join, those who lose it leave

fail.title: Could not finish verifying {{email}}
fail.network: No connection to the server · check the internet and retry
fail.index: Cloud setup incomplete: the invitation lookup index is not deployed on this project
fail.denied: The cloud rules refused the request (403)
fail.token: Could not verify the sign-in token · sign out and sign in again
fail.googleConfig: Google refused sign-in for this build: the signing fingerprint or client id does not match the cloud project
fail.playServices: Google Play services are unavailable or need an update on this device
fail.device: Unexpected error on the device ({{status}}) · see the copied details

fin.unexplained: Difference not explained by entries · check reconciliation

claims.collectedLocked: The claim is collected and posted · only its reason can be edited
claims.collectedNoDelete: The claim is collected and posted · it cannot be deleted

deposit.refundOver: The refund exceeds the deposit itself
deposit.mustDistribute: Distribute the whole deposit between deduction and refund · {{left}} left
deposit.claimCollected: The settlement excess claim is collected · its amount cannot change
deposit.carried: This contract's deposit was carried to its renewal · settle it there
deposit.receivedNo: Not received · still with the other party
deposit.excessNote: The excess over the deposit becomes a claim on the tenant
deposit.claimFirst: The settlement has an excess claim · delete it from Claims first, then edit the settlement
deposit.alreadySettled: This contract's deposit is already settled · cancel without settlement and edit the settlement from its screen
deposit.refundOverLeft: The refund exceeds what is left after the deduction · left {{left}}

vat.alreadyFiled: This period's return is already recorded as filed
vat.markFiledBody: The return is frozen at its current figures and exported with them. Later changes to its period show as differences to correct in a later return, and correction entries in its period are dated today. Continue?
vat.filedDone: Return recorded as filed and frozen
vat.frozenNote: Figures as filed · supporting schedules from current documents
vat.changedSince: Changed since filing · correct in item 14 of a later return
vat.unfileBody: If recorded by mistake: the return is computed from its documents again, and correction entries in its period return to their original dates. Continue?
vat.commercialRentControl: Commercial rent collected outside item 5 (its VAT comes with commercial leasing)

invoice.locked: An issued invoice can't be edited, returned to draft or deleted · correct it with a credit note
invoice.creditOnIssued: A credit note applies to an issued invoice only
invoice.creditPaid: The invoice is collected · set it back to «due» to reverse the collection, then issue the note
invoice.creditReason: Enter the reason for the note
invoice.creditAmount: Enter the note amount before tax
invoice.creditOver: The note exceeds what remains of the invoice
invoice.creditNeedsConnection: A credit note takes its number from the invoice sequence · a connection is needed
invoice.creditNotCollectable: A credit note is not collected
invoice.nothingDue: Nothing remains due on this invoice
invoice.lockedNote: An issued invoice is not edited · it is corrected by a linked credit note
invoice.creditBeforeInvoice: The note is dated before its invoice
invoice.creditFiledPeriod: This date's period has a filed return · pick a date in an open period
invoice.filedPeriod: This date's period has a filed return, so no invoice is issued in it · pick a date in an open period
invoice.firstIssueOwner: The first tax invoice after activation is issued by the owner · your invoice is saved as a draft; issue it after the owner issues the first one

purchase.vatSettled: This invoice's VAT is refunded or its refund was rejected, and its entry closed the account · cancel that entry from the ledger first
purchase.filedLocked: This purchase is in a filed VAT return, so it is not edited or deleted · correct it with an entry in an open period from the ledger
purchase.filedPeriod: This date's period has a filed return, so no purchase is recorded in it · use a date in an open period

bankTx.deleteBankShort: Deleting this inflow takes the bank balance ({{balance}}) below zero by {{amount}}
bankTx.cancelBankShort: The bank balance ({{balance}}) does not cover reversing an inflow of {{amount}}

props.geoSearchNote: Searching sends the address text to the OpenStreetMap service outside the app, and the map loads from it.

account.saveCopyBeforeDelete: Save a copy outside the app first

accounts.required: Enter the account name and code
accounts.systemType: A system account keeps its type · only its name can change
accounts.usedType: An account used by posted entries keeps its type
accounts.codeTaken: Account code «{{code}}» is taken · choose another
accounts.systemDelete: A system account is not deleted · automatic posting relies on it
accounts.usedDelete: Not deleted · used in {{count}} entry lines
accounts.openingDiff: Opening balances are not balanced: difference {{amount}} ({{side}}). They are saved as entered; complete the missing side to correct them.

tenants.mergeDifferentIds: Two different ID numbers are merged only with explicit confirmation
tenants.mergeDifferentIdsBody: The group has tenants with different ID numbers, most likely different people. Merge them anyway?
tenants.merged: Merged into one record with their contracts

access.moveAllPropsOnly: Moving between properties is for members with all properties

receipt.cancelledPayment: The payment is cancelled, so it has no receipt

occupants.leftQuestion: Have the occupants left? ({{n}} with the tenant)
occupants.leftNo: No · they move to the new contract
occupants.leftYes: Yes · their departure is recorded on {{date}}

suppliers.duplicate: A supplier with the same name or VAT number already exists · check the list first

compat.updateApp: Update the app to continue syncing · the organization requires a newer version
compat.updateBeforeJoin: Update the app before accepting the invitation · the organization requires a newer version

invites.ownNote: Your account already has an organization with its data. The invitation below is from another organization; accepting it makes this device a member there.

credit.overBalance: The amount exceeds the tenant's credit balance
credit.overRemaining: The amount exceeds what is left on the installment
credit.use: The tenant has a credit balance of {{amount}} · use it for this installment
credit.apply: Use the balance for this installment

bind.orgHasData: Your account already has an organization with data, so this device's data is not merged into it (its invoice and entry numbers would repeat). It stays saved on this device while you open your account's data.

backup.passwordLost: A backup password was set on this device but cannot be read, so no backup is exported or uploaded unencrypted. Set the password again, or remove it if you want unencrypted backups.

wipe.deletingFiles: Deleting files from the server · {{n}} of {{total}}
wipe.deletingCloud: Deleting your data from the cloud · {{n}}

numbering.counterBehind: This device's numbers are far ahead of the organization counter. Open the app on the owner's device to sync, then try again.

lock.title: Aqari is locked
lock.wait: Too many wrong attempts · try again in {{n}} seconds
lock.noDeviceLock: The device lock was removed or the lock setting cannot be read · confirm your Google account to open the app.
lock.accountMismatch: The account signed in on this device was not confirmed
lock.forgotPin: Forgot the code · confirm my Google account
lock.about: Asked when opening the app and when returning to it after the delay. It hides the screens only; your data on the device stays as it is.
lock.enableDevice: Turn on with fingerprint or device code
lock.noDeviceLockSet: This device has no lock · choose an app code of 4 to 8 digits.
lock.saveFailed: Could not save the app lock
